CoD: A Diffusion Foundation Model for Image Compression

CoD：面向图像压缩的扩散基础模型

10 页原论文 · 压缩基础模型 / 修正流统一训练 / 像素与潜空间 · 离线阅读

它把问题前移：能否直接训练面向压缩的生成基础模型，减少文生图先验与压缩目标的失配？

学习导读 · 以下为阅读辅助分析，与论文译文分开

先建立理解框架

核心问题

文本未必是描述图像细节的高效压缩表示，离散文本生成也不便与编解码器端到端优化。CoD 从纯图像数据联合训练条件编码器、信息瓶颈、条件解码器和扩散模型，可直接用于超低码率，也可作为 DiffC 等方法的基础模型。

码率计算

16项 VQ 码本每个索引4比特。512分辨率阶段降采样32倍，码率4/(32×32)=0.00390625 bpp。256阶段降采样16倍，码率0.015625 bpp，两阶段词元总数一致。固定条件码率不是下游 DiffC 完整码流在所有工作点的总码率。

关键公式与时间方向

本文 x_t=t x+(1−t)ε，t=0 是纯噪声，t=1 是数据，速度目标 v=x−ε。单步估计 x̂₀=ε+v₀^pred，因此 t=0 处速度 MSE 等于单步重建 MSE。统一训练让部分样本固定 t=0，其余按连续时间采样，加入明确重建约束。不同模型的 t=0 含义不同，不可直接对应 GDFA 的调度首项。

像素空间与潜空间

潜扩散输出受 VAE 重建能力限制，增加码率未必能突破。CoD 的像素版本使用块嵌入和 DDT 头控制成本，直接重建像素，探索更宽码率范围。不能据此断言像素版本在所有低码率点和所有感知指标上都更好。

实验与缺失材料

训练使用2200万公开图像，报告约20个 A100 GPU 天。与 Stable Diffusion 的成本比较包含不同任务、数据和训练设计，不是单一因素的严格等条件加速比。主要评测缩放并裁剪至512×512，与原始分辨率协议不同。上传版本正文有未解析的附录节号‘??’，且文件未包含所指附录；本文件不补造缺失内容。

与你的研究对照

GDFA 利用现有冻结扩散特征增强一致性；CoD 改变基础模型目标，让生成先验从源头面向压缩。它帮助区分适配既有先验与学习压缩先验两条路线。完整基础训练涉及大量数据和算力，短期可优先研究适合压缩的特征监督。

自检问题

CoD 与具体 DiffC 算法是什么关系？t=0 为什么能约束颜色与保真度？如何验证 VAE 上限？改变采样步数为何影响失真—感知权衡？512裁剪结果能否直接支持2K原图结论？

Figure 1. Overview of Compression-oriented Diffusion (CoD) foundation models, which are trained from scratch to jointly optimize compression and generation.

图1. 面向压缩的扩散（CoD）基础模型概览。模型从头训练，联合优化压缩与生成。

Rather than a fixed codec, CoD serves as a foundational model for downstream diffusion-based codecs such as DiffC [40], substantially enhancing their performance by replacing Stable Diffusion.

CoD 并非固定的编解码器，而是服务于 DiffC [40] 等下游扩散编解码器的基础模型；用其替换 Stable Diffusion，可显著提升下游性能。

Abstract

摘要

Existing diffusion codecs typically build on text-to-image diffusion foundation models like Stable Diffusion.

现有扩散编解码器通常建立在 Stable Diffusion 等文生图扩散基础模型之上。

However, text conditioning is suboptimal from a compression perspective, hindering the potential of downstream diffusion codecs, particularly at ultra-low bitrates.

然而，从压缩角度看，文本条件并非最优，限制了下游扩散编解码器的潜力，尤其是在超低码率下。

To address it, we introduce CoD, the first Compression-oriented Diffusion foundation model, trained from scratch to enable end-to-end optimization of both compression and generation.

为解决这一问题，我们提出首个面向压缩的扩散基础模型 CoD，从头训练以实现压缩与生成的端到端优化。

CoD is not a fixed codec but a general foundation model designed for various diffusion-based codecs.

CoD 不是固定编解码器，而是为多种扩散编解码器设计的通用基础模型。

It offers several advantages: High compression efficiency, replacing Stable Diffusion with CoD in downstream codecs like DiffC achieves SOTA results, especially at ultra-low bitrates (e.g., 0.0039 bpp);

它具有以下优势：压缩效率高，在 DiffC 等下游编解码器中以 CoD 替换 Stable Diffusion，可获得领先结果，尤其是在超低码率（例如0.0039 bpp）下；

Low-cost and reproducible training, 300× faster training than Stable Diffusion (∼20 vs. ∼6,250 A100 GPU days) on entirely open image-only datasets;

训练成本低且可复现，完全使用公开的纯图像数据集，训练速度相比 Stable Diffusion 提升约300倍（约20与6250个 A100 GPU 天）；

Providing new insights,

还能提供新的认识，

*This work was done when Zhaoyang Jia, Zihan Zheng and Naifu Xue were full-time interns at Microsoft Research Asia.

*本工作开展时，贾朝阳、郑子涵和薛乃夫均为微软亚洲研究院的全职实习生。

e.g., We find pixel-space diffusion can achieve VTM-level PSNR with high perceptual quality and can outperform GANbased codecs using fewer parameters.

例如，我们发现像素空间扩散能够在保持高感知质量的同时达到 VTM 水平的 PSNR，并以更少参数超越基于 GAN 的编解码器。

We hope CoD lays the foundation for future diffusion codec research.

我们希望 CoD 为未来扩散编解码器研究奠定基础。

Codes are released at https://github.com/microsoft/ GenCodec/tree/main/CoD.

代码公开于 https://github.com/microsoft/GenCodec/tree/main/CoD。

1. Introduction

1. 引言

Diffusion image compression [7, 15, 26, 30, 35, 43, 50] exploits the strong generative priors of denoising diffusion models [21, 31, 39] to achieve realistic image reconstruction.

扩散图像压缩[7,15,26,30,35,43,50]利用去噪扩散模型[21,31,39]强大的生成先验，实现逼真的图像重建。

To inherit such generative priors, recent diffusion codecs typically adopt large-scale pretrained text-to-image diffusion models such as Stable Diffusion [37], demonstrating impressive performance in generative image compression.

为继承这些先验，近期方法通常采用 Stable Diffusion [37] 等大规模预训练文生图扩散模型，在生成式图像压缩中表现出色。

However, when using text-to-image diffusion models in compression, the role of text conditions remains unclear.

然而，将文生图扩散模型用于压缩时，文本条件的作用仍不明确。

Although early works such as Text+Sketch [28] and PerCo [7] claim image captions can serve as a high-level semantic signal to facilitate ultra-low bitrate compression, later studies [15, 49] demonstrate that fine-tuning Stable Diffusion to discard text priors can further improve compression efficiency.

Text+Sketch [28] 和 PerCo [7] 等早期工作认为，图像描述可以作为高层语义信号辅助超低码率压缩；

Additional evidence comes from the zero-shot diffusion compression framework DiffC [43], which theoretically measures the “compression capability” of a denoising diffusion model.

但后续研究[15,49]表明，通过微调 Stable Diffusion 去除文本先验，可以进一步提高压缩效率。

When applied to Stable Diffusion, DiffC reveals that text conditions are detrimental to compression performance, especially at low bitrates.

零样本扩散压缩框架 DiffC [43] 提供了更多证据，它能够从理论上度量去噪扩散模型的“压缩能力”。

These observations suggest that text-conditioned diffusion models are not naturally suitable for compression, and that Stable Diffusion is not the ideal foundation model for diffusion codecs.

将 DiffC 应用于 Stable Diffusion 后发现，文本条件会损害压缩性能，尤其是在低码率下。

To understand this phenomenon, we analyze the underlying mechanism.

这些观察说明，文本条件扩散模型并不天然适合压缩，Stable Diffusion 也不是理想的扩散编解码基础模型。

In a standard compression formulation, where x, y, and ˆx denote the original image, compressed representation, and reconstruction, respectively, and Θ and Φ represent the trained parameters of the encoder and decoder.

为理解这一现象，我们分析其内在机制。

If we set Θ as an image captioner like BLIP-2 [29] and Φ as Stable Diffusion, we note that text-conditioned diffusion can be formulated in the compression formulation, as illustrated in the top left of Figure 1.

在标准压缩表述中，x、y 和 x̂ 分别表示原图、压缩表示与重建图像，Θ 和 Φ 分别表示编码器与解码器的训练参数。

From the perspective of compression, text conditions introduces two limitations.

若将 Θ 设为 BLIP-2 [29] 等图像描述器、Φ 设为 Stable Diffusion，就能将文本条件扩散表述为一个压缩问题，如图1左上所示。

First, human-generated text is less efficient in describing fine-grained spatial and texture details of natural images.

从压缩角度看，文本条件有两项局限。

Second, the discrete vocabularies in text is nondifferentiable to prevent joint optimization of Θ and Φ, thus making rate–distortion optimization inapplicable.

首先，人类生成的文本不能高效描述自然图像中细粒度的空间与纹理细节。

Recognizing the limitations of text conditions, a natural next step is to train a diffusion foundation model explicitly oriented toward compression.

其次，文本的离散词汇不可微，阻碍 Θ 和 Φ 的联合优化，因此无法直接进行率失真优化。

Neural codecs can learn compact, native image tokens as conditions for diffusion models, and enable end-to-end training with the diffusion model to determine the optimal image representations for coding.

认识到这些局限后，自然的下一步是训练明确面向压缩的扩散基础模型。

By carefully designing and leveraging advanced diffusion training algorithms, we introduce the first Compression-oriented Diffusion foundation model, CoD.

神经编解码器能够学习紧凑的原生图像词元作为扩散条件，并与扩散模型端到端联合训练，从而确定最适合编码的图像表示。

The architecture of CoD is simple yet effective: a native image encoder Θ to compress images into tokens, followed by an information bottleneck, and a diffusion model Φ to decode pixels conditioned on these image tokens.

通过精心设计并采用先进扩散训练算法，我们提出首个面向压缩的扩散基础模型 CoD。

The bottleneck is designed to enforce ultra-low bitrates (e.g., 0.0039 bpp), transmitting only essential semantic information while allowing the diffusion model the flexibility to generate realistic details.

其结构简单有效：原生图像编码器 Θ 将图像压缩为词元，随后经过信息瓶颈，再由扩散模型 Φ 以这些图像词元为条件解码像素。

As illustrated in the bottom left of Figure 1, CoD achieves significantly higher reconstruction fidelity compared to text-to-image foundation models.

瓶颈强制采用超低码率，例如0.0039 bpp，仅传输关键语义信息，同时允许扩散模型灵活生成逼真的细节。

It is worth noting that CoD is not a fixed codec but a general foundation model designed for diverse diffusionbased compression algorithms.

如图1左下所示，CoD 的重建保真度显著高于文生图基础模型。

In practice, it can replace Stable Diffusion in existing downstream diffusion codecs to improve performance.

需要说明，CoD 并不是固定编解码器，而是面向多种扩散压缩算法的通用基础模型。

Unlike Stable Diffusion that only provides generation priors, CoD additionally learns compression priors to substantially boost downstream performance, particularly at low bitrates.

实际使用时，可替换现有下游扩散编解码器中的 Stable Diffusion 以改善性能。

CoD offers several advantages: Low Training Cost.

Stable Diffusion 仅提供生成先验，而 CoD 还学习压缩先验，从而显著增强下游性能，尤其是低码率表现。

Compared to Stable Diffusion, CoD is far more efficient to train.

CoD 具有以下优势。

Stable Diffusion v1.5 requires about 6,250 A100 GPU days [8], whereas CoD only takes around 20 A100 GPU days (0.3% cost).

训练成本低：相比 Stable Diffusion，CoD 的训练效率高得多。

Unlike text-toimage diffusion that relies on text-image training pairs, CoD is fully self-supervised and only requires image datasets, making it easier to scale.

Stable Diffusion v1.5 约需6250个 A100 GPU 天[8]，CoD 仅需约20个，占其成本的0.3%。

Furthermore, while Stable Diffusion uses proprietary datasets, CoD is trained entirely on open datasets such as ImageNet [38], OpenImages [25], and SA-1B [24], making it easy to reproduce and unleashing the potential for future exploration across different diffusion codec architectures and training schemes.

文生图扩散依赖文本—图像配对，而 CoD 完全自监督，只需图像数据集，因此更容易扩大训练规模。

Providing New Insights. We conduct an in-depth analysis of CoD to gain insights into diffusion-based compression.

此外，Stable Diffusion 使用专有数据集，而 CoD 完全使用 ImageNet [38]、OpenImages [25] 和 SA-1B [24] 等公开数据，便于复现，并为探索不同扩散编解码结构和训练方案创造条件。

We facilitate scaling-law study of CoD to reveal how model size affects compression performance.

提供新认识：我们深入分析 CoD，以理解扩散压缩的性质。

We further show that diffusion codecs can surpass GAN-based codecs even with significantly fewer parameters.

通过规模定律研究，揭示模型大小对压缩性能的影响。

In addition, we present a comprehensive comparison between pixel-space and latentspace diffusion.

进一步表明，即使参数显著更少，扩散编解码器也能超过 GAN 编解码器。

While latent diffusion offers superior perceptual quality at low bitrates, its PSNR and bitrate range are constrained by the VAE (e.g., up to ∼26 dB PSNR at 0.6 bpp).

此外，我们全面比较像素空间与潜空间扩散。

In contrast, pixel diffusion delivers both high perceptual quality and high PSNR across a wide bitrate range (e.g., reaching near-lossless ∼47 dB PSNR at 4 bpp).

潜空间扩散在低码率下感知质量更好，但其 PSNR 和码率范围受 VAE 限制，例如0.6 bpp 时最高约26 dB。

High Compression Performance. As a compressionoriented foundation model, CoD enables high-performance downstream codecs.

相比之下，像素空间扩散在宽码率范围内兼具高感知质量与高 PSNR，例如4 bpp 时达到约47 dB 的近无损水平。

In this paper, we evaluate it using the state-of-the-art zero-shot diffusion compression method, DiffC [40, 43].

压缩性能高：作为面向压缩的基础模型，CoD 能支持高性能下游编解码器。

Compared to Stable Diffusion, DiffC with CoD achieves significantly better performance, especially at low bitrates.

本文采用先进的零样本扩散压缩方法 DiffC [40,43] 进行评估。

With pixel-space CoD, it even matches VTM [44] in PSNR while outperforming previous pixelspace perceptual codecs such as MS-ILLM [34] in FID.

与 Stable Diffusion 相比，采用 CoD 的 DiffC 性能显著更好，尤其是在低码率下。

The qualitative results in middle column of Figure 1 demonstrate that pixel-space CoD achieves much higher reconstruction fidelity, highlighting the potential of pixel diffusion to approach the theoretical rate–distortion–perception trade-off.

采用像素空间 CoD 后，其 PSNR 甚至达到 VTM [44] 水平，同时 FID 优于 MS-ILLM [34] 等像素空间感知编解码器。

The contributions of this work can be summarized as:

图1中列的定性结果表明，像素空间 CoD 的重建保真度高得多，体现了像素扩散逼近理论率—失真—感知权衡的潜力。

We introduce the first compression-oriented diffusion foundation model, CoD, designed to replace Stable Diffusion in diffusion codecs.

本文贡献概括如下：提出首个面向压缩的扩散基础模型 CoD，用于替代扩散编解码器中的 Stable Diffusion；

• CoD enables low-cost, reproducible training, supporting exploration of new network architectures.

实现低成本、可复现的训练，支持探索新网络结构；

• CoD delivers high compression performance, especially on ultra-low bitrates.

提供高压缩性能，尤其是在超低码率下；

• CoD pushes the boundaries of diffusion codecs, demonstrating the potential of pixel-space diffusion as a pathway toward the optimal rate–distortion–perception trade-off.

推动扩散编解码器的性能边界，展示像素空间扩散通向最优率—失真—感知权衡的潜力。

Figure 2. Framework overview of CoD in pixel and latent spaces.

图2. 像素空间和潜空间 CoD 的框架概览。

CoD consists of a condition encoder, an entropy bottleneck, a condition decoder and a diffusion model which is decoupled to DiT backbone and DDT head [46].

CoD 包含条件编码器、熵瓶颈、条件解码器，以及拆分为 DiT 主干与 DDT 头[46]的扩散模型。

CoD is trained with rectified flow [31], where 1 −α% samples are trained at t = 0 to jointly optimize distortion and perception.

CoD 使用修正流[31]训练，其中1−α%的样本在 t=0 处训练，以联合优化失真与感知。

2. Compression-oriented Diffusion

2. 面向压缩的扩散

In this section, we introduce the implementation details of the proposed compression-oriented diffusion models, CoD.

本节介绍所提出的面向压缩扩散模型 CoD 的实现细节。

2.1. Pipeline

2.1. 流程

We implement CoD in both pixel and latent spaces.

我们分别在像素空间与潜空间实现 CoD。

As illustrated in Figure 2, given an input data x, CoD performs: Condition Encoding.

如图2所示，给定输入 x，CoD 执行如下操作。

An encoder firstly compresses x into compact representations.

条件编码：编码器首先将 x 压缩为紧凑表示。

Following [12], we stack residual blocks [18] and attention layers [42] to construct the encoder.

遵循文献[12]，我们堆叠残差块[18]和注意力层[42]构建编码器。

The output is at 1/32 resolution of the original images.

输出分辨率为原图的1/32。

Entropy bottleneck. It is designed to maintain an ultralow bitrate for y, encouraging the diffusion model to learn strong generative capabilities.

熵瓶颈：其目标是让 y 保持超低码率，促使扩散模型学习强大的生成能力。

This can be implemented as scalar quantization with entropy models [5], vector quantization [12], or finite scalar quantization [33].

可通过带熵模型的标量量化[5]、向量量化[12]或有限标量量化[33]实现。

For simplicity, we use vector quantization with a codebook size of N = 24 = 16, corresponding to 4 bits/(32 × 32) = 0.0039 bpp.

为简单起见，我们采用码本大小 N=2⁴=16 的向量量化，对应4 bits/(32×32)=0.0039 bpp。

Condition Decoding. The condition decoder reconstructs intermediate compression conditions c from the image tokens y.

条件解码：条件解码器从图像词元 y 重建中间压缩条件 c。

The decoder adopts similar structures as the encoder.

解码器与编码器采用类似结构。

The condition c is at a 1/16 resolution of the original image.

条件 c 的分辨率为原图的1/16。

Diffusion-based reconstruction. The diffusion module denoises a randomly sampled Gaussian noise over T steps under the guidance of condition c to reconstruct ˆx.

扩散重建：扩散模块在条件 c 引导下，对随机采样的高斯噪声去噪 T 步，重建 x̂。

Following DDT [46], we decouple DiT backbone and DDT head to enhance capacity.

遵循 DDT [46]，我们将 DiT 主干与 DDT 头解耦，以增强容量。

DDT performs denoising at 1/16 resolution, where the condition c is concatenated with the noised input along the channel dimension at each step for guidance.

DDT 在1/16分辨率上去噪，每一步都将条件 c 与带噪输入沿通道维拼接作为引导。

In the latent space, since VAE latents are already at 1/8 resolution, we apply a 2×2 patch embedding to downsample them to 1/16, and upsample the output of DDT head back to 1/8 before passing to the VAE decoder.

在潜空间中，VAE 潜变量已具有1/8分辨率，因此先用2×2块嵌入降采样至1/16，再将 DDT 头输出上采样回1/8，送入 VAE 解码器。

In the pixel space, we directly use a 16×16 patch embedding to map the noised images to 1/16 resolution, and adopt the pixel DDT head from [45], where each feature predicts a neural field that reconstructs a corresponding 16 × 16 patch.

在像素空间中，直接采用16×16块嵌入将带噪图像映射到1/16分辨率，并使用文献[45]的像素 DDT 头，使每个特征预测一个神经场，重建对应的16×16图像块。

Since the DiT backbone runs at 1/16 resolution of original images, pixelspace CoD has a similar computation complexity as in latent space.

由于 DiT 主干均在原图1/16分辨率上运行，像素空间 CoD 与潜空间版本计算复杂度相近。

Details are in the appendix.

细节见附录。

Original CoD w/o Unified Training of 𝐿𝑅𝐹 CoD w/ Unified Training of 𝐿𝑅𝐹

原图；不采用 L_RF 统一训练的 CoD；采用 L_RF 统一训练的 CoD。

2.2. Diffusion Training

2.2. 扩散训练

Preliminary. Denoising diffusion models [43] model the data distribution by progressively perturbing a clean sample x with Gaussian noise ε, transforming p(x) into a standard Gaussian distribution.

预备知识：去噪扩散模型[43]通过逐渐向干净样本 x 加入高斯噪声 ε，将 p(x) 转换为标准高斯分布，从而建模数据分布。

At timestep t, it is formulated as, where αt and σt define the noise schedule.

在时间步 t，其表达式如下，其中 α_t 和 σ_t 定义噪声调度。

The process can be expressed as a stochastic differential equation (SDE), with drift f(t) and diffusion g(t) determined by αt and σt.

该过程可表示为随机微分方程（SDE），其中漂移项 f(t) 与扩散项 g(t) 由 α_t 和 σ_t 确定。

Score-based models [39] learn the score function of p(x) to solve the reverse SDE and generate samples.

基于得分的模型[39]学习 p(x) 的得分函数，以求解反向 SDE 并生成样本。

Rectified Flow (RF) [31] reinterprets diffusion as a deterministic transformation.

修正流（RF）[31]将扩散重新解释为确定性变换。

It removes the stochastic term from the SDE and adopts a linear transition schedule:

它移除 SDE 的随机项，并采用线性过渡调度：

So the trajectory follows a simple ordinary differential equation (ODE) formulated as:

因此，轨迹遵循如下简单的常微分方程（ODE）：

Figure 4. Scaling law analysis on Kodak at 256 × 256.

图4. 在256×256分辨率 Kodak 上进行的规模定律分析。

All CoD models are at 0.016 bpp while MS-ILLM is at 0.021 bpp.

所有 CoD 模型均为0.016 bpp，MS-ILLM 为0.021 bpp。

Instead of estimating the score, RF directly learns the velocity field vt, providing more stable training, faster inference, and a clearer geometric view of generation. Unified Training with Rectified Flow.

RF 不估计得分，而是直接学习速度场 v_t，因此训练更稳定、推理更快，对生成过程的几何解释也更清楚。

CoD predicts the velocity vt so it can be trained with the rectified flow loss, where vpred t denotes the predicted velocity field.

采用修正流的统一训练：CoD 预测速度 v_t，因此可用修正流损失训练，其中 v_t^pred 表示预测速度场。

Theoretically, optimizing LRF reduces the Kullback–Leibler (KL) divergence between the reconstructed and original distributions [13], which can reflect the perception term in ratedistortion-perception (R-D-P) theory [6].

理论上，优化 L_RF 会减小重建分布与原始分布之间的 KL 散度[13]，这可以反映率—失真—感知（R-D-P）理论[6]中的感知项。

Hence, optimizing LRF naturally promotes perceptual quality.

因此，优化 L_RF 自然有利于感知质量。

However, we find that rectified flow loss mainly guarantee the reconstruction consistency of the structure instead of color information (see Figure 3).

然而，我们发现修正流损失主要保证结构重建一致性，而不能充分保证颜色信息，见图3。

From a compression viewpoint, this is consistent with R–D–P theory: standard diffusion training neglects the distortion term, leading to limited reconstruction fidelity.

从压缩角度看，这与 R-D-P 理论一致：标准扩散训练忽略失真项，导致重建保真度受限。

To overcome this, we introduce a unified formulation that integrates a distortion term into the rectified flow loss. Since the one-step estimate at t = 0 is ˆx0 = ε+vpred 0 , the rectified flow loss can be rewritten given v0 = x −ε:

为此，我们提出统一表述，将失真项融入修正流损失。由于 t=0 处的单步估计为 x̂₀=ε+v₀^pred，且 v₀=x−ε，修正流损失可改写为：

Thus, optimizing LRF at t = 0 directly minimizes one-step reconstruction distortion to incorporate a distortion term during training.

因而，在 t=0 处优化 L_RF 会直接最小化单步重建失真，从而在训练中引入失真项。

As illustrated in Figure 2, during training we randomly select α% samples with t ∈[0, 1] and the rest with t = 0 to enable the unified training.

如图2所示，训练时随机选取 α%的样本令 t∈[0,1]，其余样本取 t=0，实现统一训练。

Discussion. Unified training is designed for continuous flows, where the probability of sampling a fully noised state t = 0 approaches zero.

讨论：统一训练针对连续流设计，在连续采样中，取到完全带噪状态 t=0 的概率趋近于零。

We observe that color reconstruction in CoD is largely determined by its first denoising step; thus, the absence of t = 0 optimization often leads to noticeable color shifts.

我们观察到，CoD 的颜色重建主要由第一步去噪决定，因此缺少 t=0 优化时常出现明显偏色。

In contrast, DDPM-based codecs such as PerCo [7] employ discrete timesteps uniformly sampled as tDDPM ∈1, · · · , 1000, inherently including optimizing of fully noised state.

相比之下，PerCo [7] 等 DDPM 编解码器使用离散时间步，在 t_DDPM∈{1,…,1000} 中均匀采样，天然包含对完全带噪状态的优化。

This can be viewed as a special case of our formulation with 1 −α% = 1/1000.

这可视为我们表述中1−α%=1/1000的特殊情况。

2.3. Implementation Details

2.3. 实现细节

Datasets. Foundation models require large-scale training to achieve optimal performance.

数据集：基础模型需要大规模训练才能达到最佳性能。

Unlike text-to-image generation that depends on text-image data pairs, CoD is fully self-supervised and requires only image datasets, making large-scale scaling more accessible.

不同于依赖文本—图像配对的文生图生成，CoD 完全自监督，只需图像，因此更易扩展训练规模。

In this paper, we use ImageNet-21K [38], OpenImage [25] and SA-1B [24], including a total of 22M images.

本文采用 ImageNet-21K [38]、OpenImage [25] 和 SA-1B [24]，共2200万张图像。

All datasets are publicly available, facilitating reproducibility for future research.

所有数据集均公开，方便后续复现。

Loss Function. For the information bottleneck, we adopt the codebook commitment loss LC [12].

损失函数：信息瓶颈使用码本承诺损失 L_C [12]。

Diffusion training employs the rectified flow loss LRF and the representation alignment loss LREPA with DINOv2 [36].

扩散训练采用修正流损失 L_RF，以及以 DINOv2 [36] 为目标的表示对齐损失 L_REPA。

Additionally, an auxiliary head (Figure 2) reconstructs both original pixels and DINOv2 features from the condition c to enhance condition learning.

此外，辅助头（图2）从条件 c 同时重建原始像素与 DINOv2 特征，以增强条件学习。

Further analysis of this auxiliary loss Laux is in the appendix.

辅助损失 L_aux 的进一步分析见附录。

The overall objective is where λ = 0.5, β = 0.25 and γ = 1.0.

总目标如下，其中 λ=0.5、β=0.25、γ=1.0。

Training Details. We incorporate several advanced techniques for diffusion training.

训练细节：我们结合了多种先进扩散训练技术。

Timesteps are sampled following a log-normal distribution, which is further enhanced by the unified training strategy introduced in Section 2.2.

时间步按对数正态分布采样，并采用第2.2节的统一训练策略进一步增强。

CoD is progressively trained from low to high resolution: first at 256 × 256 for 400k steps with a batch size of 128, and then fine-tuned at 512 × 512 for 150k steps with a batch size of 64.

CoD 从低分辨率逐步训练到高分辨率：先以256×256、批量128训练40万步，再以512×512、批量64微调15万步。

The encoder downsamples images to 1/16 at 256 × 256 resolution (0.0156 bpp) and to 1/32 at 512 × 512 (0.0039 bpp), ensuring that the total number of patches and overall bit cost remain consistent.

编码器在256×256时降采样至1/16（0.0156 bpp），在512×512时降采样至1/32（0.0039 bpp），确保图像块总数与总比特开销一致。

Figure 5. Comparison of CoD and Stable Diffusion on Kodak at 512 × 512 resolution.

图5. 在512×512 Kodak 上比较 CoD 与 Stable Diffusion。

(left) Pixel-space CoD enables zero-shot distortionperception controlling by adjusting the sampling steps. CoD is at 0.0039 bpp and PerCo is at 0.0036 bpp.

左：像素空间 CoD 可通过调整采样步数，在零样本条件下控制失真—感知权衡。CoD 为0.0039 bpp，PerCo 为0.0036 bpp。

(right) Text conditions harms performance of zero-shot algorithm DiffC on Stable Diffusion, while CoD condition boosts LPIPS at low-bitrate.

右：文本条件会损害基于 Stable Diffusion 的零样本算法 DiffC 的性能，而 CoD 条件可改善低码率 LPIPS。

In addition, pixel-space CoD is not limited by the SD-VAE thus demonstrating wider bitrates, higher PSNR and higher potential in perceptual quality.

此外，像素空间 CoD 不受 SD-VAE 限制，呈现更宽码率范围、更高 PSNR 和更大感知质量潜力。

Figure 6. Visual comparison between Stable-Diffusion-based codecs and latent-space CoD under ultra-low bitrates.

图6. 超低码率下，基于 Stable Diffusion 的编解码器与潜空间 CoD 的视觉比较。

Training Costs. CoD is trained on 4 NVIDIA A100 GPUs for approximately 5 days, totaling around 20 A100 GPU days.

训练成本：CoD 使用4张 NVIDIA A100 GPU 训练约5天，总计约20个 A100 GPU 天。

This represents only about 0.3% of the training cost of Stable Diffusion v1.5 [37], primarily because: (1) CoD learns the most informative compression conditions end-toend, rather than relying on high-dimensional, human-defined text embeddings;

这仅约为 Stable Diffusion v1.5 [37] 训练成本的0.3%，主要原因包括：CoD 以端到端方式学习最有信息量的压缩条件，而不依赖高维、人为定义的文本嵌入；

(2) the unified rectified flow training stabilizes and accelerates convergence;

统一修正流训练稳定并加快收敛；

(3) advanced optimization strategies such as REPA [51] further improve efficiency.

REPA [51] 等先进优化策略进一步提高效率。

Diffusion Sampling. For ODE-based sampling, we employ the Adam-like-2nd solver [45] with 25 steps.

扩散采样：ODE 采样采用 Adam-like-2nd 求解器[45]，使用25步。

We use classifier-free guidance [20] with scales of 3.0 for pixel space and 1.25 for latent space to enhance conditional generation.

为增强条件生成，我们采用无分类器引导[20]，像素空间引导尺度为3.0，潜空间为1.25。

3. Analysis on Foundation Model

3. 基础模型分析

In this section, we conduct an in-depth analysis of CoD to investigate its performance and underlying characteristics.

本节深入分析 CoD，研究其性能与内在特征。

More analysis are in the appendix.

更多分析见附录。

3.1. Evaluation

3.1. 评估

CoD naturally operates as a codec at 0.0039 bpp.

CoD 自身就可以作为0.0039 bpp 的编解码器。

We evaluate its compression performance on the Kodak [10] dataset at 512×512 resolution.

我们在512×512 Kodak [10] 上评估压缩性能。

To ensure fair comparison among foundation models, we employ the same SD-VAE and compare our latent-space CoD with Stable-Diffusion-based codecs, including zero-shot DiffC [43], DDCM [35], and fine-tuned PerCo (SD) [26] and OSCAR [15].

为公平比较基础模型，采用相同的 SD-VAE，将潜空间 CoD 与基于 Stable Diffusion 的编解码器比较，包括零样本 DiffC [43]、DDCM [35]，以及微调的 PerCo (SD) [26] 和 OSCAR [15]。

As shown in Figure 6, CoD achieves superior reconstruction quality.

如图6所示，CoD 获得更好的重建质量。

A more detailed quantitative comparison is presented in Section 4.

更详细的定量比较见第4节。

3.2. Scaling Law

3.2. 规模定律

Most diffusion codecs are constrained by the parameter count of Stable Diffusion (approximately 860M), making it difficult to study parameter scaling.

多数扩散编解码器受 Stable Diffusion 约8.6亿参数规模的约束，难以研究参数扩展规律。

It also remains unclear whether the performance advantages of diffusion codecs over GAN-based codecs (e.g., MS-ILLM [34]) stem from architectural improvements or simply from model scaling.

扩散编解码器相对 MS-ILLM [34] 等 GAN 方法的优势，究竟来自架构改进还是模型规模扩大，也不明确。

To explore this, we train pixel-space CoDs with varying channel dimensions at 256×256 resolution for 400k steps and evaluate them on Kodak.

为探索这一问题，我们在256×256分辨率下训练不同通道宽度的像素空间 CoD，共40万步，并在 Kodak 上评估。

As shown in Figure 4, we observe a clear trend: increasing model parameters consistently enhances compression performance.

如图4所示，随着参数量增加，压缩性能持续提升，趋势清晰。

Compared with the GAN-based MS-ILLM (181M parameters), CoD achieves notably better reconstruction quality even with only 49M parameters, confirming that the performance gain primarily originates from algorithmic improvements rather than model size.

相比1.81亿参数的 GAN 方法 MS-ILLM，仅4900万参数的 CoD 就能显著改善重建质量，说明性能收益主要来自算法改进，而非模型规模。

3.3. Zero-Shot Distortion-Perception Control

3.3. 零样本失真—感知控制

The proposed unified training jointly optimizes one-step distortion and multi-step perception, endowing CoD with the ability to control the distortion–perception trade-off directly through the number of sampling steps.

所提出的统一训练联合优化单步失真与多步感知，使 CoD 能直接通过采样步数控制失真—感知权衡。

As shown in Figure 5 (left), at 0.0039 bpp, pixel-space CoD attains the best perceptual quality at 25 steps and achieves a 3.4 dB PSNR improvement (from 16.2 dB to 19.6 dB) when reduced to a single step.

如图5左所示，在0.0039 bpp 时，像素空间 CoD 使用25步获得最佳感知质量；减少至单步后，PSNR 提高3.4 dB，从16.2升至19.6 dB。

Intermediate step counts smoothly interpolate between these two states.

中间步数在这两种状态间平滑过渡。

In contrast, diffusion codecs without this formulation (e.g., PerCo (SD)) fail to exhibit such controllable improvement through step reduction.

相比之下，没有这种训练表述的扩散编解码器，例如 PerCo (SD)，无法通过减少步数获得这种可控改善。

Figure 7. Visualization comparison on the CLIC2020 test set across bitrates from low (top) to high (bottom).

图7. CLIC2020 测试集上，从低码率（上）到高码率（下）的视觉比较。

3.4. Revisiting Pixel-Space Diffusion

3.4. 重新审视像素空间扩散

Recent diffusion codecs typically operate in the latent space of a KL-VAE, achieving impressive results at low bitrates (e.g., <0.1 bpp).

近期扩散编解码器通常在 KL-VAE 潜空间中运行，在低码率（例如小于0.1 bpp）下表现出色。

However, their performance is fundamentally constrained by the entropy and reconstruction capacity of the underlying VAE.

然而，其性能根本上受底层 VAE 的熵与重建能力限制。

As shown in Figure 5 (right), DiffC [43] built on Stable Diffusion cannot surpass the reconstruction limit of the SD-VAE (PSNR 25.77 dB, LPIPS 0.069), with a bitrate ceiling around 0.26 bpp.

如图5右所示，基于 Stable Diffusion 的 DiffC [43] 无法超越 SD-VAE 的重建上限，即 PSNR 25.77 dB、LPIPS 0.069，码率上限约为0.26 bpp。

Similarly, latent-space CoD remains bounded by VAE quality even up to 0.60 bpp, indicating that latent diffusion codecs inherently operate within a limited quality and bitrate range.

类似地，潜空间 CoD 即使达到0.60 bpp，也仍受 VAE 质量约束，说明潜扩散编解码器固有地只能在有限质量和码率范围内工作。

In contrast, pixel-space CoD directly models raw pixels to overcome this constraint.

相反，像素空间 CoD 直接建模原始像素，克服这一限制。

It can scale the bitrate beyond 1.0 bpp while continuously improving reconstruction quality.

其码率可扩展至1.0 bpp以上，同时持续改善重建质量。

Pixel-space CoD surpasses latent diffusion models in LPIPS at around 0.3 bpp and maintains substantially higher PSNR across the entire range.

约0.3 bpp 时，像素空间 CoD 的 LPIPS 超过潜扩散模型，并在整个码率范围内保持显著更高的 PSNR。

This demonstrates the potential of pixel-space diffusion as a more general and unconstrained approach to learned compression in future research.

这体现了像素空间扩散作为未来更通用、约束更少的学习式压缩方法的潜力。

4. Downstream Compression Performance

4. 下游压缩性能

In this section, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation of CoD when integrated into downstream compression frameworks.

本节全面评估 CoD 集成到下游压缩框架后的性能。

Since most diffusion-based codecs do not release their training code, we employ the zero-shot compression method DiffC [43] on CoD for comparison.

由于多数扩散编解码器未公开训练代码，我们将零样本压缩方法 DiffC [43] 应用于 CoD 进行比较。

Additional downstream results are presented in the appendix, e.g., finetuning one-step CoD achieves real-time and SOTA performance (Section ??), and CoD-based perceptual loss that significantly enhances MS-ILLM [34] performance (Section ??).

更多下游结果见附录，例如微调单步 CoD 后可实现实时且领先的性能（原文节号为??），以及基于 CoD 的感知损失可显著改善 MS-ILLM [34]（原文节号为??）。

Benchmarks and Baselines. Experiments are conducted on the Kodak [10], CLIC2020 test set [41] and Div2K [1].

基准与对比方法：实验使用 Kodak [10]、CLIC2020 测试集[41]和 Div2K [1]。

All images are resized and center-cropped to a resolution of 512 × 512.

所有图像均缩放并中心裁剪至512×512。

We report distortion using PSNR and perceptual quality using LPIPS [52], DISTS [9], and FID [19].

采用 PSNR 衡量失真，LPIPS [52]、DISTS [9] 和 FID [19] 衡量感知质量。

Following [35], FID is computed on extracted patches (64 × 64 for Kodak and 128 × 128 for CLIC2020).

遵循文献[35]，FID 基于提取的图像块计算，Kodak 使用64×64，CLIC2020 使用128×128。

Bitrate is measured in bits per pixel (bpp).

码率以每像素比特数 bpp 衡量。

In addition to diffusion codecs (DiffC, DDCM, PerCo (SD), and OSCAR; see Section 3.1), we further compare against the latent-space codec DiffEIC [30] and pixel-space codecs including the traditional codec VTM [44] and perceptual codecs HiFiC [32], MS-ILLM [34], CDC [50] and TACO [27].

除第3.1节的 DiffC、DDCM、PerCo (SD)、OSCAR 等扩散编解码器外，还比较潜空间 DiffEIC [30]，以及像素空间传统编解码器 VTM [44] 和感知编解码器 HiFiC [32]、MS-ILLM [34]、CDC [50]、TACO [27]。

We also discuss StableCodec [53] and OneDC [49] which are built on pretrained one-step diffusion models in the appendix.

附录还讨论基于预训练单步扩散模型的 StableCodec [53] 和 OneDC [49]。

Pixel-space Comparison. The rate-distortion curves on pixel space codecs are shown in Figure 8.

像素空间比较：率失真曲线见图8。

Pixel space codecs are free of the limitation of VAE latents thus can achieve wider bitrates and quality ranges. Across all bitrates, our codec achieves superior PSNR, DISTS and FID values.

像素空间方法不受 VAE 潜变量限制，因此能覆盖更宽的码率与质量范围。在各码率下，我们的方法具有更好的 PSNR、DISTS 和 FID。

Notably, perceptual codecs HiFiC, MS-ILLM, CDC (ρ = 0.9) and TACO are optimized with LPIPS, whereas pixel-space CoD is not, which explains performance on LPIPS.

需要注意，HiFiC、MS-ILLM、CDC（ρ=0.9）和 TACO 使用 LPIPS 优化，而像素空间 CoD 没有，这解释了其 LPIPS 表现。

Surprisingly, our codec achieves comparable BPP–PSNR performance to VTM (BD-Rate is −2.1% using VTM as anchor) while delivering significantly better perceptual quality.

令人意外的是，我们的方法取得了与 VTM 相近的 BPP–PSNR 性能，以 VTM 为基准的 BD-Rate 为−2.1%，同时感知质量显著更好。

In contrast, HiFiC, MS-ILLM and CDC (ρ = 0.9) improve perceptual quality at the expense of PSNR.

相比之下，HiFiC、MS-ILLM 和 CDC（ρ=0.9）以牺牲 PSNR 换取感知提升。

TACO removes the GAN [14] loss to balance distortion and perception, but fails to achieve an optimal trade-off.

TACO 去掉 GAN [14] 损失以平衡失真与感知，但未实现最优权衡。

By comparison, DiffC with pixel-space CoD attains the best balance across all bitrates.

相较而言，采用像素空间 CoD 的 DiffC 在所有码率下取得最佳平衡。

Although pixel diffusion has been less explored than latent diffusion, our results demonstrate that CoD highlights the potential of pixel diffusion to achieve a superior rate–distortion–perception trade-off.

虽然像素扩散研究少于潜扩散，我们的结果表明 CoD 展示了像素扩散实现更优率—失真—感知权衡的潜力。

Latent-space Comparison. The rate-distortion curves on latent space codecs are shown in Figure 9.

潜空间比较：率失真曲线见图9。

Compared to existing latent-space codecs, DiffC with latent-space CoD achieves the best reconstruction quality at lower bitrates (e.g., <0.02 bpp).

相比现有潜空间编解码器，采用潜空间 CoD 的 DiffC 在较低码率，例如小于0.02 bpp时，重建质量最好。

At higher bitrates, the gap narrows as performance approaches the SD-VAE limit.

在高码率下，性能接近 SD-VAE 上限，差距缩小。

At some points (e.g., FID at 0.02 bpp on CLIC), CoD performs slightly worse than DiffC due to smaller training scale, which can likely be closed with larger data and training in the future.

在某些点，例如 CLIC 上0.02 bpp处的 FID，CoD 略逊于 DiffC，原因是训练规模较小，未来增加数据和训练可能缩小差距。

Visualization. Figure 7 compares with SD-based DiffC, PerCo (SD), and the pixel-space MS-ILLM. At low bitrates, CoD achieves higher fidelity than SD-based codecs and more realistic details than prior pixel-space methods.

视觉结果：图7与基于 SD 的 DiffC、PerCo (SD) 以及像素空间 MS-ILLM 比较。低码率下，CoD 比 SD 方法保真度更高，比既有像素空间方法细节更逼真。

At high bitrates, latent codecs are constrained by the SD-VAE, e.g., small characters appear heavily distorted.

高码率下，潜空间方法受 SD-VAE 限制，例如小字符严重失真；

In contrast, pixelspace CoD reconstructs accurate details.

相比之下，像素空间 CoD 能重建准确细节。

Figure 8.

图8. 与像素空间编解码器比较。

Comparison with pixel-space codecs. Note: HiFiC, MS-ILLM, CDC, and TACO are optimized using LPIPS, whereas CoD is not.

注意：HiFiC、MS-ILLM、CDC、TACO 均使用 LPIPS 优化，而 CoD 没有。

So pixel-space CoD may not achieve the best LPIPS at certain bitrates, despite outperforming in PSNR, DISTS and FID.

因此，尽管像素空间 CoD 在 PSNR、DISTS 和 FID 上更好，某些码率下的 LPIPS 可能并非最佳。

5. Related Works

5. 相关工作

5.1. Generative Image Compression

5.1. 生成式图像压缩

Unlike neural image codecs [4, 5, 16] that primarily minimize reconstruction distortion (MSE), generative image compression [2, 3, 17, 22, 23, 48] aims to achieve both low distortion and high perceptual quality.

不同于主要最小化重建失真（MSE）的神经图像编解码器[4,5,16]，生成式图像压缩[2,3,17,22,23,48]旨在同时实现低失真与高感知质量。

Early works [32, 34] introduced conditional GANs to enhance perceptual realism, successfully improving perceptual quality compared to MSE-optimized codecs, albeit at the cost of higher reconstruction distortion.

早期工作[32,34]引入条件 GAN 增强感知真实性，相比 MSE 优化编解码器成功改善了感知质量，但增加了重建失真。

TACO [27] further incorporates textual information to mitigate MSE degradation, yet still falls short in achieving an ideal distortion–perception balance.

TACO [27] 进一步引入文本信息以缓解 MSE 退化，但仍未达到理想的失真—感知平衡。

To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to demonstrate that pixel-space diffusion can attain VTM-level distortion while delivering superior perceptual quality to GAN-based codecs.

据我们所知，本文首次证明像素空间扩散能够达到 VTM 水平的失真，同时感知质量优于 GAN 编解码器。

5.2. Diffusion Image Compression

5.2. 扩散图像压缩

Recent advances in generative image compression increasingly leverage the powerful generative priors of diffusion models to achieve higher realism.

近期生成式图像压缩越来越多地利用扩散模型强大的生成先验，以获得更高真实性。

PerCo [7] compresses image representations and text captions as conditions, finetuning a pretrained latent diffusion model for perfect realism.

PerCo [7] 压缩图像表示和文本描述作为条件，并微调预训练潜扩散模型，以追求完美真实性。

Figure 9.

图9. 与潜空间编解码器比较。

Comparison with latent-space codecs. Latent-space CoD demonstrates state-of-the-art performance towards low bitrates.

潜空间 CoD 在低码率方向表现出领先性能。

In contrast, DiffEIC [30] and OSCAR [15] show that removing the text bitstream can yield better overall performance.

相比之下，DiffEIC [30] 和 OSCAR [15] 表明，去掉文本码流可获得更好的整体性能。

Other approaches [11, 47] investigate zero-shot compression using pretrained diffusion models without fine-tuning.

另一些方法[11,47]探索无需微调的预训练扩散模型零样本压缩。

DiffC [40, 43] introduces reverse-channel coding to progressively compress increasingly noised representations, while DDCM [35] adopts random codebooks to encode the random sampled noises.

DiffC [40,43] 引入反向信道编码，逐步压缩噪声越来越强的表示；DDCM [35] 则采用随机码本编码随机采样噪声。

Most of these methods depend on pretrained diffusion foundation models such as Stable Diffusion, which are theoretically suboptimal for compression.

这些方法大多依赖 Stable Diffusion 等预训练扩散基础模型，而这类模型在理论上并非最适合压缩。

CoD offers an alternative, compression-oriented diffusion foundation model that can serve as a stronger backbone for such approaches, enabling superior performance.

CoD 提供面向压缩的替代基础模型，可作为这些方法更强的主干，实现更好性能。

Another early exploration on pixel-space diffusion codec is CDC [50].

像素空间扩散编解码器的另一项早期探索是 CDC [50]。

However, CoD differs in several key aspects.

然而，CoD 在几个关键方面不同。

First, CoD emphasizes training at ultra-low bitrates (∼0.0039 bpp) for strong generative prior, and it relies purely on diffusion loss.

首先，CoD 强调在约0.0039 bpp的超低码率下训练，以学习强生成先验，其扩散生成训练依靠扩散损失。

In contrast, CDC is trained at high bitrates (>0.2 bpp), where dense information limits generative learning.

相比之下，CDC 在高码率，大于0.2 bpp下训练，密集的信息限制了生成能力的学习。

Consequently, CDC requires perceptual losses such as LPIPS, otherwise its perceptual quality drops to the level of an MSE-optimized codec.

因此，CDC 需要 LPIPS 等感知损失，否则感知质量会降至 MSE 优化编解码器的水平。

Second, CoD embodies the concept of a foundation model, scaling training to push the frontier of compression research, while CDC does not consider scaling laws.

其次，CoD 采用基础模型理念，通过扩大训练规模推动压缩研究边界，而 CDC 未研究规模定律。

Finally, CoD offers insights beyond the model itself: we provide a comprehensive analysis of scaling behavior, pixel- vs. latent-space and conditioning modalities, offering broader insights for future research.

最后，CoD 提供模型之外的认识：全面分析扩展规律、像素与潜空间、条件模态，为未来研究提供更广泛启示。

6. Conclusion and Limitation

6. 结论与局限

To conclude, we present CoD, the first compression-oriented diffusion foundation model.

总而言之，我们提出首个面向压缩的扩散基础模型 CoD。

CoD is trained from scratch and enables end-to-end joint optimization of compression and diffusion generation, substantially improving diffusionbased compression performance, particularly at ultra-low bitrates.

CoD 从头训练，实现压缩与扩散生成的端到端联合优化，显著改善扩散压缩性能，尤其是在超低码率下。

CoD is trained entirely on open datasets with low computational cost, facilitating reproducibility and further research.

CoD 完全采用公开数据集，计算成本较低，便于复现和后续研究。

Building on CoD, we investigate the scaling laws of diffusion codecs and demonstrate the potential of pixel-space diffusion towards strong R–D–P trade-off across a wide bitrate range.

基于 CoD，我们研究了扩散编解码器的规模定律，并展示像素空间扩散在宽码率范围内实现良好 R-D-P 权衡的潜力。

We believe CoD establishes a solid foundation for future advances in diffusion-based compression.

我们认为 CoD 为未来扩散压缩发展奠定了坚实基础。

However, CoD still has some limitations.

不过，CoD 仍存在一些局限。

First, although extending CoD to higher resolutions (e.g., 2K) is technically feasible, it is not yet trained for high-resolution inputs.

首先，尽管技术上可扩展至2K等更高分辨率，它目前尚未针对高分辨率输入进行训练。

Second, CoD does not meet real-time coding requirements.

其次，CoD 尚不满足实时编码要求。

With continued advances in diffusion distillation, we hope real-time will become attainable in the near future.

随着扩散蒸馏持续发展，我们希望未来能够实现实时处理。
